heading: Chef Ranveer Brar shares govind gatta recipe to try on special occasions: See step-by-step preparation
author: ABOUT THE AUTHORDebapriya Bhattacharya
paragraphs: Sometimes, trying a simple variation on a classic comfort dish takes it to the next level and makes it the perfect thing to serve at home on special occasions. Celebrity chef and MasterChef India judge Ranveer Brar’s govind gatta recipe is just like that.
